change_policy: Rules may change only by explicit versioned repository update. Chat summaries or handoffs cannot silently override this registry.

rules.rule: Offline simulation and historical research MUST NOT require live/realtime odds unless a specific experiment explicitly tests price/odds behavior.
rules.rationale: Odds are not needed to evaluate prediction science and should not block simulation throughput.

rules.rule: Odds are purchase-boundary inputs. During live/manual operation the system may report minimum required odds or price thresholds and the Owner may verify current odds before purchase.
rules.rationale: Separates prediction research from volatile market-price acquisition.

rules.rule: For forward-style historical backtests and prospective tests, race outcome/result/payout information MUST remain hidden until prediction inputs and predictions are frozen.
rules.rationale: Prevents result leakage and post-hoc reconstruction.

rules.rule: Official or established historical racecard/result sources may be used as source evidence under the Keirin research protocol, but PRE fields and outcome fields must be separated in the experiment record.
rules.rationale: Allows reproducible historical science without contaminating predictor inputs.

rules.rule: Preserve exact authoritative track circumference. 333.3m, 335m, 400m, 500m and any other observed official length are separate research lanes. Nearest-bucket coercion and unsupported-length dropping are forbidden.
Frozen B1a evaluation uses the exact frozen predictor lineage without retuning, reweighting or threshold adjustment inside confirmatory/prospective evaluation sets.

Prospective, preregistered-retrospective and ordinary retrospective evidence classes must remain explicitly separated and must never be relabelled to a stronger evidence class after outcomes are known.
Missing mandatory PRE fields must not be guessed or synthesized. Fail closed or exclude before outcome access with the exclusion reason recorded.
Do not cherry-pick races after outcomes. When a full-day experiment is preregistered, score the complete successfully frozen card without post-hoc case deletion.

Owner-free research, collection, implementation and validation should continue without stopping. Stop only at a genuine Owner authorization, credential, spend, protected-data, live-effect or other Owner boundary.
Runtime remains OFF and automatic betting remains OFF unless separately and explicitly authorized. Research artifacts alone never activate live effects or spend.

GitHub is the canonical continuity store. Chat is an ephemeral terminal, not long-term research memory. CURRENT STATE, RULE REGISTRY, EXPERIMENT LEDGER and datasets/artifacts must be repository-backed.

Default Owner-facing execution replies should be concise: current position, new finding, next executable action and one progress line. Large tables, logs and simulation outputs belong in repository artifacts/files.
Scientific progress percentage changes only when evidence strength materially advances; file count or raw case count alone does not automatically increase progress.

A historical racecard URL is NOT sufficient proof of PRE-only blindness. Before upgrading historical evidence above ordinary retrospective, the captured source must be verified not to expose target outcomes at collection time, or a repository/archive snapshot must demonstrably predate the target outcome. If the source page can expose same-meeting or target-race finishes, fail closed and classify the batch as retrospective even when predictor inputs themselves omit outcome fields.
rules.rationale: Post-event historical racecard pages can embed current-meeting results; this was directly observed on Omiya 2026-05-23 and invalidates source-URL-only blindness claims.
